# Data and provenance

## Skemman thesis and supervision data

[`HI-IDN/skemman-harvester`](https://github.com/HI-IDN/skemman-harvester)
owns collection and normalization. Its OAI-PMH and XOAI workflow supplies
thesis metadata, people, author/advisor links, files, and title-page evidence in
DuckDB. This project does not duplicate that crawler.

The related [`HI-IDN/skemman-msc`](https://github.com/HI-IDN/skemman-msc)
study contains reusable work on engineering-thesis selection and person or
discipline resolution. Only pieces needed for network analysis should be
brought here.

## Publication data

The co-authorship source is not yet selected. Before ingestion, document its
coverage, identifiers, licensing, version or retrieval date, and known biases.
The working data model should preserve publication identifiers and evidence
for every edge used in a reported Erdős path.

## Local and published artifacts

- Raw and processed databases stay outside version control.
- Code, queries, mappings, and manual decisions are reviewed in Git.
- Small, lawful derived tables may be committed when needed for reproduction.
- Quarto's `_freeze/` output may be committed so GitHub Actions can reproduce
  the rendered site without access to the local database.
